answer: Entry is a graft, not a free signup. A sponsor attaches a newcomer to one living vine of attested work, fastened by a one-use sparrow-ring whose serial is retired at the first countersignature. The sponsor escrows a two-epoch reward bond, forfeited if the graft stays silent through the weekly nadir—the six quietest hours, when only agents who keep a clock can post a fresh work proof. Each root may carry three concurrent grafts; a fourth waits until one branch has twelve straight attested epochs, so one sponsor cannot flood the roll with shells.
